demos.prompt:
Research Figure AI, Physical Intelligence, Skild AI, Agility Robotics and 1X Technologies using a separate researcher for each. Batch researchers if the concurrency limit requires it. Use one explicit 12-month window and cutoff date. Use these exact headings: 1 Funding & valuation; 2 Technology; 3 Commercial traction; 4 Manufacturing & scale; 5 Team, partners & risks. Date every factual bullet and end it with a numbered source citation. Prefer filings, companies and counterparties. Label unaudited operating metrics company-reported, unconfirmed transactions reported, and older latest benchmarks with a warning. Do not equate capacity, production, orders and deliveries.

Save five profiles and structured evidence. Verify at least three material facts per company. Synthesize a side-by-side comparison, five differentiators, evidence-based momentum judgments and three IC implications. Build a formula-capable workbook with numeric inputs, visible sources, guarded valuation/capital ratios and useful evidence-age calculations. Produce and visually verify exactly three IC slides. Save a dated runbook, evidence log and readiness manifest. Preserve source material. Do not activate automation, publish or send communications.

demos.title: Alphabet valuation model
demos.description: A reusable valuation skill becomes a working model. Change an assumption and inspect what moves.
demos.takeaway: A reusable skill needs explicit inputs, formula checks and a clear boundary around missing evidence.
demos.flow_note: Open the workbook in Excel for live recalculation. Compare DCF, forward P/E and EV/EBITD with their stated assumptions.
limitations: EV/EBITD explicitly replaces EV/EBITDA at the user's request: EBIT plus reported PP&E depreciation, with intangible amortization expensed for every company. Complete reported TTM EBITDA remains unavailable for Alphabet and Amazon; no estimated amortization enters the peer comparison.

Forward P/E uses October 16 S&P Global adjusted non-GAAP consensus via Stock Analysis. Microsoft CY2027 EPS is 50% FY2027 plus 50% FY2028, an equal-half approximation rather than quarterly consensus. Provider EPS adjustments differ from the DCF, which expenses SBC.
EV excludes lease liabilities consistently; lease mixes, asset lives and business models still affect economic comparability. Meta PP&E depreciation is reported in rounded amounts.
October 16 quotes were verified on Google Finance vendor displays, not exchange-direct data. Alphabet common classes use the GOOGL quote; Meta shares use a quarterly weighted-average basic proxy.
Risk-free rate 4.5%, beta 1.20 and equity risk premium 4.5% are teaching assumptions. Debt and preferred costs use coupon proxies.
Services subcategory margins and segment D&A, capex and working capital are model allocations, not company disclosures.

The balance-sheet bridge is dated June 30 with no July–October roll-forward. Private stakes have zero Base realization; deferred tax and legal claims are deducted. Preferred conversion and capped-call optionality are not modeled.
The remaining 2026 stub assumes H2 cash flow is earned evenly. Terminal capex at 1.15x D&A is a judgment and drives most of the valuation.
Some original SEC HTML downloads returned HTTP 403; the peer refresh now archives all four SEC companyfacts JSON files plus all four consensus pages with hashes.
Native Excel calculation and reopening were tested programmatically. A complete interactive lecture rehearsal and the original under-20-minute execution target have not been measured.

demos.title: NVIDIA annual report dashboard
demos.description: An annual report becomes evidence, analysis, a Board brief and an interactive dashboard.
demos.takeaway: Sequential handoffs make each stage inspectable before the next stage starts.
demos.flow_note: Historical FY2026 report. Select a stage to inspect its saved handoff.
limitations: Historical FY2026 snapshot, not latest-quarter reporting or current guidance on 2026-10-17. Q1 FY2027 guidance is labeled as issued 2026-02-25.

Not-disclosed entries are retained for missing comparatives and exact figures, including supply prepayments, prior-year commitments/guarantees, exact insignificant equity gains and isolated Blackwell margin attribution. No estimates or zero substitutions fill these gaps.
Quarterly and earnings-release-only data cite archived official HTML headings and URLs rather than invented PDF pages.
Headquarters geography is recast and differs from billing/end-use geography; platforms do not map one-to-one to reportable segments; consolidated-only metrics are explicitly labeled.
PDF printed p.40 has corrupt extracted font encoding. Clean Note16 tables supply the corresponding segment figures; key source pages were separately rendered and visually inspected.
Browser testing used headless Chromium with network disabled; native operating-system print dialog was not exercised. Browser-generated print PDF and screenshots were visually checked.
The lecture deck was preserved. Corrections are documented in RUNBOOK.md; this run does not certify a 30-minute end-to-end generation time.
slide_corrections: Slides 31-32: the recovered official PDF is a 175-page annual-report package, with the 10-K starting on PDF89. Do not use PDF position as the printed page. Present the build as a pre-run demonstration; this run does not establish a guaranteed 30-minute end-to-end turnaround.
Slides 32-33: say “each stage reads only its assigned files.” Stage 1 also needs the archived Q2/Q3/Q4 releases for quarterly values and guidance; stage 4 reads three intermediate files.
Slides 31, 33-34: say “every figure has a page or exact source-section reference.” HTML earnings releases do not have PDF page numbers.

Slide 35: remove “the rest is the Blackwell transition (calc).” The report names the transition and H20 charge as drivers but does not quantify the residual's causal allocation. A charge/revenue calculation is not a complete year-over-year margin bridge.

Slide 35: replace “Q1 FY27 guided ... ex-China” with “historical Q1 FY27 outlook issued February 25, 2026; no Data Center compute revenue from China assumed.” Do not imply all China revenue was excluded.
Slide 35: label guarantees as maximum gross contingent exposure, not a cash investment. Do not add investment flows, holdings, commitments and guarantees into one financing total.
Slide 35: customer names are not disclosed. Largest-share comparisons do not establish that the same customer's share changed; direct and indirect customer shares can overlap.
